rationale: Screen-only finding: revised Jinteki had 32 flatline wins vs 2 original, while agenda wins were 18 vs 19. Test the two imported Clearinghouse slots directly, holding the other 42 cards, deck size, identity, ice and agendas fixed.
comparison: Revised Jinteki confirmation games vs the same list replacing 2 Clearinghouse with 2 Predictive Planogram. A specific two-slot trade, not a card-isolation experiment with identical alternatives.
multiplicity: Primary confirmation and this mechanism contrast each use 97.5% intervals, a Bonferroni family-wise 95% target for two planned held-out comparisons. Both resample whole shared-seed clusters.
criterion: Mechanism contrast is confirmed if its 97.5% seed-cluster interval excludes zero. Report win-reason changes separately as descriptive.
